Robert E. Brooks Sr.

Independent candidate for Governor, Oklahoma · Open seat

Insurance broker

Robert E. Brooks Sr. is an insurance broker from Moore who is running for governor of Oklahoma as an independent. He calls his campaign the "Farmer Servant" movement and uses the slogan "Vote We the People." He is listed as an independent candidate for governor on the Oklahoma State Election Board's November 3, 2026 general election ballot.

Where Sr. stands

Income tax
Has published a plan to eliminate Oklahoma's state income tax and says he is the only candidate for governor with such a plan.
Property tax
Proposes phasing out personal property taxes as part of his tax plan.
Taxes
His platform proposes a tax modernization plan that his campaign says is intended to protect working families and reward investment in Oklahoma.
Health care / Medicaid
Proposes letting every Oklahoma resident buy a public option health plan modeled on SoonerCare, available alongside employer coverage.
Partisanship
Says the Republican and Democratic parties have "pitted neighbor against neighbor" and that voters want leadership and unity.
Government services technology
Proposes "The People's App," a technology platform meant to connect citizens directly to public services.

Background

  • Insurance broker; owns an insurance brokerage and has helped families with Medicare and health insurance
  • Resident of Moore, Oklahoma
  • Filed as an independent candidate for governor, April 2026
  • No prior elected office found
